# W3 (sqlfluff) test environment — EXACT pins, frozen 2026-08-16 from the venv that
# produced every measurement recorded in task.yaml and README.md.
#
# WHY this file exists: upstream requirements_dev.txt is completely unpinned ("ruff",
# "pytest", "mypy[mypyc]", ...), so installing from it resolves to whatever PyPI serves
# that day. That is fine for a project CI and fatal for a benchmark task: the pinned
# commit would no longer imply a pinned environment, and SPEC 2.8 checks 4/5/9 would be
# measuring a moving target. These pins were produced by `uv pip freeze`, not authored.
#
# Regenerate deliberately, never silently:
#   uv pip freeze --python .venv/bin/python | grep -v '^-e '
# The two local editables are installed separately by stack_cmds.install (--no-deps):
#   -e .   and   -e plugins/sqlfluff-plugin-example  (test/core/plugin_test.py needs it)
